text.p: Following are the main stories in Croatian newspapers on Friday.
- Local Serbs will not have to serve in the Croatian army, according to a memorandum sent by the Croatian government to the local Serbs in Podunavlje.
- Railway strike ends following an agreement between the state-owned railway company and the trade unions.
- Privatisation ministry faces the biggest move so far -- mass privatisation.

- Power problems: Due to a mechanical fault, Slovenia's Krsko nuclear power plant, that supplies electricity for Croatian consumption, has ground to a halt. Still Croats continue using up a record amount of electricity.
- Croatia to be awarded international rating by January 15.
- The new labour regulations ban smoking from all working places except in specially designated areas. -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
